lines.text: God says to comfort His people and speak tenderly to Jerusalem, because her forced labor is completed and iniquity pardoned.
A voice calls to prepare the LORD's way in the Red Sea, and all humanity will see His glory.
All flesh is like grass that withers, but the word of our God stands forever.
Zion is told to go up on a high mountain and tell the cities of Samaria, "Here is your God!"
The Lord GOD comes with might, and like a shepherd He gathers the lambs in His arms.
